stem:
Lata needs a handle that will not get too hot on a pan.

What should she check in the material?

options.text: Whether its properties (such as not conducting heat well) fit the use.
Whether it is a metal, because every metal handle stays cool.
Properties of materials do not matter for objects.

teacher.key_rationale: Choose a material whose properties match the job. Shine and 'all metals stay cool' do not.
